name: dw-solo
description: A persistent workflow for repos only you read. One artifact per change instead of three, one quality pass instead of five. Skills: dw-init (scaffold a solo repo), dw-grill (bounded interview, one question at a time), dw-shape (one CHANGE.md with a task checklist), dw-next (resume point and build step in one), dw-land (verdict, then promote decisions and drop the scaffolding), dw-git (git ops by your own conventions), dw-doctor (read-only health check), dw-setup-precommit (husky + lint-staged). Self-contained — do not install alongside dw-planning or dw-quality.
